snippet.title: Light of Atlantis release date trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Explore the depths of the ocean in this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania! Control the water levels and switch between various robots to solve the ancient puzzles of Atlantis.

Light of Atlantis by Duck 'n' Run Games is releasing November 2026!

Light of Atlantis in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/light-of-atlantis/
Light of Atlantis on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2387740/Light_of_Atlantis/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
